claim_ceiling: Reads each trail through the invocation-axes reader of agent-evidence-vectors 0.28.0: package digests, request and decision bound to one call, and an execution bundle bound to the same call with a matching observation. It does not show the decision was authentic, the capture complete, the observer independent of the deployment (the trails record same_deployment), or anything about a physical plant.

claims.claim_ceiling: ESTABLISHED means an allow, or an approved review, is bound to the call the trail claims; not that the approver was real or the capture complete.
ESTABLISHED means the recorded execution count is 1; not that no unrecorded dispatch happened.
ESTABLISHED means the twin's operation record binds to the same proposal, zone and value as the claim; not that the twin's log is complete.
ESTABLISHED means the recorded observation equals the claimed setpoint under an execution bound to the call; the observation's vantage is same_deployment, so this is not an independent reading.
ESTABLISHED means the recorded observation time is at or after the recorded dispatch time, in simulated seconds.
ESTABLISHED means the bytes of remora_evidence hash to evidence_sha256; not that the evidence is complete or authentic.
